Elitecon International Stock Rises Amid Market Volatility and SEBI Action

Elitecon International's stock experienced a significant jump of 11% despite a broader market downturn, attributed by some reports to SEBI easing banking restrictions. The company's stock has seen substantial declines over the past year, falling over 85%. The market volatility is occurring amidst global concerns, including the US-Iran war.
